provenance.source_quote: The oral absorption of all selected compounds except for CyA and PTZ was well described by a first-order process with the estimated absorption rate constant (ka) ranging from 0.0007 minutes^-1 for FTY720 to 0.149 minutes^-1 for HB.

The oral absorption of all selected compounds except for CyA and PTZ was well described by a first-order process with the estimated absorption rate constant (ka) ranging from 0.0007 minutes^-1 for FTY720 to 0.149 minutes^-1 for HB.

The oral absorption delays for CyA and PTZ were reasonably captured by incorporating the three-compartment transit model yielding first-order transit rate constants (ktr) of 0.019 and 0.089 minutes^-1.
